key_insight: Intrinsic Lie point-symmetry generators can be recovered directly from differential-equation data without symbolic determining equations or a closed-form governing system.
engineering_relevance: Recovered symmetries can expose geometric structure useful for model reduction and scientific machine learning.
method: Construct a sampled determining operator on jet-space data using prolongation.
Apply sequential subspace restrictions to separate intrinsic generators from redundant, solution-dependent, and geometrically trivial directions.
Fit a fixed nonlinear dictionary linear in trainable coefficients, with a rank-stabilization preflight under dictionary refinement.
evidence_signal: On a controlled benchmark with a known 11-dimensional represented intrinsic symmetry algebra, the method recovered all represented generators, reproduced Lie brackets to numerical precision, and approximated one known generator beyond the training domain.
watch_item: Recovery is limited by dictionary representation; the preflight test flags cases where the represented intrinsic symmetry algebra does not stabilize under refinement.
paper_title: Data-driven discovery of intrinsic Lie point symmetries of differential equation systems
